# Ohio, United States Genealogy



[United States](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/United_States_Genealogy "United States Genealogy")

Ohio

Guide to **Ohio ancestry, family history, and genealogy** birth records, marriage records, death records, census records, and military records.

## Information

Ohio is a state in the Midwestern portion of the United States. Ohio became a state on 1 March 1803, having been created from the Northwest Territory, and it's capital is Columbus. It is divided into 88 counties.[[1]](#cite_note-1) *See [Ohio History](https://www.familysearch.org/en/wiki/Ohio_History "Ohio History") for more information.*

## Ohio Clickable Map

Many genealogy records are kept on the county level in the United States. Click on a county below to go to the county Wiki article listing more information.
